decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has its own page in both years, which signals continued commitment. It sits close to the core offer, so it costs little to keep, and its prospects still justify holding the option open.

The hyaluronic serum is a low-cost extension produced in small batches within existing capabilities. It is still mentioned after two years with no sign of failure, so too little has been revealed to justify abandoning it.

The cleansing oil launched only in 2024 and likely took over the cleansing role of the dropped cleansing milk. Its value is still uncertain and it is cheap to keep, so real options logic favors keeping it open.
